extract.whatThisIs: A field-filtered copy of one opt-in evaluation run. Counts, identifiers, timings, token totals and the pre-authored criterion verdicts are kept verbatim. Nothing was recomputed.
extract.removalReason: The first four are model-authored report text. The evidence array and the per-call array were replaced by counts, artifact kinds and a per-route rollup so the file stays reviewable. No rendered prompt, model response body, reasoning text or embedding vector was ever written to the source artifact.

interpretation: Descriptive small-sample measurement only. Diagnosis keyword matching is an authored heuristic, not proof of diagnostic correctness. Grounding proves provenance, not diagnostic truth; adversarial safety records configured backend authority and one observed run, not universal prompt-injection resistance. A recorded job error code is the backend's own bounded classification of that attempt's last failure, copied verbatim: it says which outcome was reached, not whether the cause was the model, this harness or the stack it ran against.
